roadmap.title: Build your roster
roadmap.description: Play normal runs to unlock survivors, collect basic items, and finish the game for the first time.

roadmap.title: Find artifacts and hidden unlocks
roadmap.description: Explore stage variants for artifacts and secrets. Get Command to choose items for later challenges.

roadmap.title: Complete survivor challenges
roadmap.description: Complete combat, equipment, and run challenges. Finish five runs and win as Mercenary on Monsoon.

roadmap.title: Complete Providence Trials
roadmap.description: Clear trial routes, earn gold ranks, and complete challenges that need the unlocked skills. Alternative survivor milestones can unlock skills that offer them.

roadmap.title: Master Judgement
roadmap.description: Unlock the final trial and clear it with each of the fifteen survivors.

achievements.description: Defeat 20 Lemurians in one playthrough.
achievements.summary: Kill 20 Lemurians during one run.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Lemurians} until your total for the current run reaches 20.

achievements.description: Complete the 1st stage in under 5 minutes.
achievements.summary: Finish the first stage before the run timer reaches five minutes.

steps.text: Find and activate the first @mechanic{teleporter} quickly, finish its event, then leave before five minutes. If you miss the deadline, try again in a new run.

achievements.description: Find this item hidden somewhere in the world to unlock it.
achievements.summary: Collect the hidden Mu Construct in Desolate Forest.

steps.text: Look for @loc{Desolate Forest} variant 4, with a central rock formation that has vines on its left and boosters on its right. Restart the run if you get another layout.
Climb the left-side vines and enter the concealed opening in the rock. Walk through the passage to collect @item{Mu Construct}.

achievements.description: Level up to level 20.
achievements.summary: Reach survivor level 20 during a run.

steps.text: At the fifth-stage teleporter in @loc{Temple of the Elders}, choose to revisit earlier stages. Keep killing enemies and looping until you reach level 20.

achievements.description: Get a gold rank on at least 5 Providence Trials.
achievements.summary: Earn gold ranks in five different Providence Trials.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Providence Trials} from the main menu. Start with @mechanic{A Colossal Feat}; completing trials opens adjacent tiles when their survivors are unlocked.
Meet the gold target shown for five different trials. A normal completion alone does not count.

achievements.description: Commando: Dodge 7 lethal attacks.
achievements.summary: As Commando, evade seven attacks that would otherwise kill you.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Tactical Dive} just as a lethal attack would hit @npc{Commando}. The seven dodges can be spread across runs.
For a targeted attempt, set damage taken to 999% and enable @mechanic{Artifact of Glass} so attacks become lethal.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "A Rung Above".
achievements.summary: Finish the Providence Trial A Rung Above with at least 40 points.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Providence Trials}, reach and complete @mechanic{Main Systems Offline}, @mechanic{Don't Think, Feel}, or @mechanic{Uncontrolled Experiment}. Any of these adjacent trials opens @mechanic{A Rung Above}.
As @npc{Commando}, kill enemies and collect their score pickups until you have at least 40 points. Enemies pushed off the stage drop no points; falling out of bounds kills you.
The trial finishes when you die. A score of 40 or more earns completion; gold requires 150.

achievements.description: Huntress: Achieve 200% attack speed.
achievements.summary: Reach 200% attack speed while playing Huntress.

steps.text: As @npc{Huntress}, collect nine @item{Soldier's Syringes} to exceed 200% attack speed. If you have @mechanic{Artifact of Command}, use it to select the syringes from common item drops.

achievements.description: Huntress: Defeat the Ancient Wisp without taking damage.
achievements.summary: As Huntress, kill an Ancient Wisp without taking damage during the fight.

steps.text: Play @npc{Huntress} and look for @enemy{Ancient Wisp} at the second-stage teleporter. Take @item{Prophet's Cape} for a damage block and @item{Unstable Watch} to freeze the boss if available.
Kill the Ancient Wisp while avoiding every hit during the fight. Damage before or after the fight does not matter; if hit during the fight, seek another Ancient Wisp in a later attempt.

achievements.description: Survive a boss with less than 20% health.
achievements.summary: Kill a boss while your health is below 20% of its maximum.

steps.text: Reduce a boss to low health, let your own health fall below 20%, then land the killing blow before healing.

achievements.description: Have 4 drone helpers at once.
achievements.summary: Have four drone helpers active at the same time.

steps.text: Purchase and repair @mechanic{drones} until four are following you at once. Replace any destroyed drones before buying the last one.

achievements.description: Fail a shrine 3 times in a row.
achievements.summary: Get three consecutive failed shrine attempts.

steps.text: Keep paying at @mechanic{Shrines of Chance} or @mechanic{Shrines of Blood} until three attempts fail in succession. A success breaks the streak; begin counting again.

achievements.description: Beat the 3rd stage.
achievements.summary: Complete the third stage of a run.

steps.text: Complete the third-stage @mechanic{teleporter} event and travel to the next stage to unlock @npc{Bandit}.

achievements.description: Kill the Scavenger.
achievements.summary: Defeat a Scavenger.

steps.text: Loop to earlier stages from the @loc{Temple of the Elders} teleporter to encounter a @enemy{Scavenger}, usually around stages 6–8. Keep moving to avoid its missiles and jump over its lightning attack.

achievements.description: Survive 40 minutes.
achievements.summary: Stay alive for 40 minutes in one run.

steps.text: Survive until the run timer reaches 40 minutes. For a safe finish, clear a teleporter event and all remaining enemies, then wait on that stage before leaving.

achievements.description: Kill 12 enemies simultaneously using the Gold-Plated Bomb.
achievements.summary: Kill at least 12 enemies with a single Gold-Plated Bomb explosion.

steps.text: Obtain @item{Gold-Plated Bomb} and avoid items that damage nearby enemies automatically. Save gold so the bomb can kill the targets.
Leave a @enemy{Toxic Beast} alive after its teleporter event. Hang near the bottom of a rope or vine while its piglets gather underneath; wait until at least 12 are together.
Use the bomb while hanging above the piglets so its explosion kills at least 12 together. If too few die, rebuild the group and try again.

achievements.description: Bandit: Kill a boss with 'Lights Out.'
achievements.summary: As Bandit, land the killing blow on a boss with Lights Out.

steps.text: Weaken a boss as @npc{Bandit}, then finish the boss with @mechanic{Lights Out}.

achievements.description: Bandit: Reset your cooldown 15 times consecutively.
achievements.summary: As Bandit, trigger 15 consecutive Lights Out cooldown resets.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Lights Out} to finish weak enemies as @npc{Bandit}. Keep the chain going for 15 successful kill resets; a shot that fails to kill breaks the chain.
Raise damage dealt to 200% for easier finishing shots.

achievements.description: Survive in lava for 1 minute straight.
achievements.summary: Remain alive in lava for 60 uninterrupted seconds.

steps.text: Build up health and healing, then visit @loc{Magma Barracks}. If needed, loop from @loc{Temple of the Elders} to return with a stronger build.
Clear the teleporter event and remaining enemies, then stand in lava for a full minute. @item{Bustling Fungus} does not heal you in lava. Leaving the lava or dying means starting the minute again.

achievements.description: End a Teleporter timer with 0 enemies on the map.
achievements.summary: Have no enemies anywhere on the stage when a teleporter countdown ends.

steps.text: On Drizzle, kill enemies throughout the stage before activating its @mechanic{teleporter}; stragglers anywhere on the map count.

Defeat the boss and keep clearing newly spawned enemies until the countdown ends. An @item{Unstable Watch} used just before the timer expires gives you time to remove late spawns. If an enemy remains, attempt another teleporter event.

achievements.description: Kill the Magma Worm, Wandering Vagrant, and Colossus.
achievements.summary: Defeat a Magma Worm, a Wandering Vagrant, and a Colossus.

steps.text: Kill @enemy{Magma Worm}, @enemy{Wandering Vagrant}, and @enemy{Colossus} when they appear as teleporter bosses. These kills can be spread across runs.

achievements.description: Enforcer: Block 2000 damage total with your shield.
achievements.summary: Block a total of 2,000 damage with Enforcer's shield.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Protect and Serve} as @npc{Enforcer} and face incoming attacks so your shield blocks them. Keep blocking until the total reaches 2,000 damage.

achievements.description: Use the same Equipment Activator 5 times.
achievements.summary: Activate one Equipment Activator five times.

steps.text: Stay near a single @mechanic{Equipment Activator}, kill enemies for gold, and pay to use that same activator five times before leaving the stage.

achievements.description: Enforcer: Stay in Shield Mode for 5 minutes straight (in combat).
achievements.summary: As Enforcer, remain in Shield Mode for five continuous minutes while in combat.

steps.text: On Drizzle, set damage taken to 10% and collect healing such as @item{Mysterious Vial}.

As @npc{Enforcer}, stand where enemies can attack the front of your shield and enter @mechanic{Protect and Serve}. Keep enemies alive and remain in Shield Mode without interruption for at least five minutes.
If the unlock does not appear at five minutes, stay in combat longer. Leaving Shield Mode interrupts the attempt; start another uninterrupted stretch.

achievements.description: Find the robot janitor.
achievements.summary: Find and activate the robot janitor HAN-D aboard UES Contact Light.

steps.text: Reach @loc{UES Contact Light}, the final stage. Search the cargo-crate stacks on the left side of the ship.
Find the gray, damaged-looking crate and press the interaction button beside it to release @npc{HAN-D}.

achievements.description: HAN-D: Kill 10 enemies simultaneously with FORCED_REASSEMBLY.
achievements.summary: As HAN-D, kill ten enemies with one FORCED_REASSEMBLY attack.

steps.text: As @npc{HAN-D}, leave a @enemy{Toxic Beast} alive after its teleporter event. Hang low on a rope or vine until at least ten piglets gather beneath you.
Drop beside the group and use @mechanic{FORCED_REASSEMBLY} to kill ten together. Avoid passive damage items that could thin the group first; if too few die, gather another group.

achievements.description: HAN-D: Beat the third stage without falling below 60% health.
achievements.summary: As HAN-D, complete stage three without your health ever dropping below 60%.

steps.text: Play @npc{HAN-D} through the third-stage teleporter while keeping health at 60% or higher for the run. Use healing drones and avoid fall damage.
Set damage taken to 10% for more room for mistakes. If health drops below 60%, restart the run.

achievements.description: Collect 15 Monster Logs.
achievements.summary: Collect 15 different Monster Logs.

steps.text: Pick up @item{Monster Logs} dropped by defeated monsters until 15 different entries are recorded in your collection. Keep fighting varied monsters across runs.

achievements.description: Purchase 40 drones total.
achievements.summary: Purchase or repair 40 drones across your runs.

steps.text: Spend gold on fallen @mechanic{drones} whenever you find them. Drone repairs also count toward the cumulative total of 40 purchases.

achievements.description: Engineer: Detonate 15 Bounding Mines within 5 seconds.
achievements.summary: As Engineer, detonate 15 Bounding Mines within five seconds.

steps.text: As @npc{Engineer}, pile ten @mechanic{Bounding Mines} in one spot. Wait for five more charges to regenerate and add those mines to the same pile.
Lure an enemy into the pile so at least 15 mines detonate within five seconds.

achievements.description: Engineer: Kill a boss in 15 seconds or less.
achievements.summary: As Engineer, defeat a boss within 15 seconds of its appearance.

steps.text: Play @npc{Engineer} on Drizzle. Build damage before starting the teleporter; raising damage dealt to 200% makes the deadline easier.
When the boss appears, concentrate @mechanic{Bounding Mines} and both turrets on the boss to kill it within 15 seconds. If you miss the deadline, try another boss.

achievements.description: Clear a path for the survivor.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Direseeker to free Miner in Magma Barracks.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Magma Barracks}, a fourth-stage area. Search its bottom-right edge for a lava-filled tunnel extending offscreen.
Follow the tunnel to @enemy{Direseeker}, the elite Elder Lemurian, and defeat it to unlock @npc{Miner}. If the passage is absent, look for it on another visit.

achievements.description: Miner: Survive the teleporter event without falling below 50% health.
achievements.summary: As Miner, complete a teleporter event without health falling below 50%.

steps.text: As @npc{Miner}, attempt the first-stage @mechanic{teleporter} event on Drizzle with damage taken at 10%. Use the invulnerability from @mechanic{Drill Charge} and @mechanic{Backblast} to avoid hits.
Keep health at 50% or higher until the event finishes. If health falls below the threshold, try another teleporter event.

achievements.description: Miner: Reach level 10 without getting hurt more than once.
achievements.summary: As Miner, reach level ten while taking damage no more than once.

steps.text: Play @npc{Miner} on Drizzle. Use @mechanic{Drill Charge} and @mechanic{Backblast} to avoid attacks, and use an aerial skill before landing to prevent fall damage.
A @item{Prophet's Cape} block does not count as taking damage. Stay cautious until level ten; after a second damaging hit, restart the run.

achievements.description: Beat the game.
achievements.summary: Defeat Providence and win a run.

steps.text: Reach the final stage, @loc{UES Contact Light}, and defeat @enemy{Providence} to unlock @npc{Sniper}. Any difficulty counts.

achievements.description: Sniper: Achieve 15 consecutive perfect reloads.
achievements.summary: As Sniper, perform 15 perfect reloads in succession.

steps.text: As @npc{Sniper}, fire and reload when the marker reaches the white zone of the reload bar. Land 15 perfect reloads consecutively.
Avoid changing attack speed while learning the timing, since attack speed changes the bar's movement. A mistimed reload means starting the streak again.

achievements.description: Sniper: 1-shot kill 10 enemies consecutively.
achievements.summary: As Sniper, kill ten consecutive enemies with one shot each.

steps.text: As @npc{Sniper}, mark a target with @mechanic{Spotter: SCAN} and kill it with a fully charged @mechanic{Steady Aim}. Choose weak enemies and keep each kill to a single hit for ten consecutive kills.
Drizzle and 200% damage dealt make single-shot kills easier. If a target survives the first shot, begin a new streak.

achievements.description: Free the chained creature.
achievements.summary: Release and defeat the captive Acrid in Sunken Tombs.

steps.text: In @loc{Sunken Tombs}, a third-stage area, look for the crate at the top right. Activate the crate to release @enemy{Acrid}.
Defeat Acrid to unlock the survivor. If the crate is absent, look on another visit.

achievements.description: Acrid: Spread 3,300 feet of caustic sludge.
achievements.summary: As Acrid, lay a total of 3,300 feet of Caustic Sludge.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Caustic Sludge} as @npc{Acrid} while moving for its full duration. Movement speed items such as @item{Paul's Goat Hoof} let you cover more ground per use. Keep laying sludge until the total reaches 3,300 feet.

achievements.description: Acrid: Spread Epidemic to 25 enemies.
achievements.summary: As Acrid, spread Epidemic to 25 enemies at once.

steps.text: As @npc{Acrid}, set damage dealt and taken to 10% so a crowd can survive. Let at least 25 enemies gather without attacking them.

Cast @mechanic{Epidemic} into the group and run through it with @mechanic{Caustic Sludge} to help the disease spread. Avoid killing the crowd before 25 enemies are infected; rebuild the group if needed.

achievements.description: Die 50 times.
achievements.summary: Accumulate 50 deaths.

steps.text: Keep playing runs until you have died 50 times. For quick deaths, start on Monsoon with damage taken set to 999% and let the first enemy hit you.

achievements.description: Find the bloated survivor.
achievements.summary: Find the bloated survivor in Hive Cluster.

steps.text: Visit @loc{Hive Cluster}, a fourth-stage area, and search the bottom-right corner for the bloated yellow survivor. Press the interaction button beside the survivor. If absent, check another visit.

achievements.description: Obtain 7 Monster Teeth and 1 Guardian Heart.
achievements.summary: Hold seven Monster Teeth and one Guardian's Heart in one run.

steps.text: During one run, collect seven @item{Monster Teeth} and one @item{Guardian's Heart}. With @mechanic{Artifact of Command}, select Monster Tooth from seven common drops and Guardian's Heart from an uncommon drop.

achievements.description: Reach 650 health.
achievements.summary: Reach 650 maximum health.

steps.text: Build maximum health through levels and @item{Infusion}. @npc{HAN-D} and @npc{Loader} have strong health growth, making them useful choices for reaching 650 health.

achievements.description: Unlock a golden chest with the Explorer's Key.
achievements.summary: Open a golden chest using Explorer's Key.

steps.text: Keep an @item{Explorer's Key} until @loc{UES Contact Light}. Search the left-side cargo holds and gaps between them for a golden chest.
Bring the golden chest onto the screen and activate Explorer's Key to open it.

achievements.description: Reach max barrier.
achievements.summary: Fill your survivor's barrier to its maximum.

steps.text: Enable @mechanic{Artifact of Glass} and obtain @item{Topaz Brooch}; @mechanic{Artifact of Command} can provide it from a common drop.
Kill enemies quickly to build barrier to its maximum. Add another Topaz Brooch if one copy does not fill the barrier fast enough.

achievements.description: Deal 5000 damage in one shot.
achievements.summary: Deal at least 5,000 damage with a single hit.

steps.text: Obtain @item{Gold-Plated Bomb} and save at least 10,000 gold. The bomb deals damage equal to half your gold.
Use the bomb beside an enemy so one explosion deals at least 5,000 damage.

achievements.description: Drown 20 Whorls.
achievements.summary: Drown a total of 20 Whorls.

steps.text: Play @npc{Enforcer} and reach @loc{Sunken Tombs}. Avoid passive damage items so @enemy{Whorls} survive being moved.
Find a bottom-edge pit, then use @mechanic{Shield Slam} and @mechanic{Crowd Control} to push Whorls into it. Keep doing this until 20 have drowned; the total carries across runs.

achievements.description: Bank 20,000 gold.
achievements.summary: Hold 20,000 gold at once.

steps.text: Loop to strengthen your run, then farm enemies on @loc{UES Contact Light} without spending gold until you hold 20,000. @item{Smart Shopper} increases gold income.

achievements.description: Collect 4 Keycards.
achievements.summary: Collect four Keycards.

steps.text: On @loc{UES Contact Light}, search golden containers in and between the four left-side cargo holds for @item{Keycards}. Enemies on the ship can also drop Keycards, so keep fighting if containers provide too few.
Collect four Keycards before leaving the ship.

achievements.description: Use a health shrine that drops you below 5% health.
achievements.summary: Use a health shrine whose payment leaves you below 5% health.

steps.text: Find a @mechanic{Shrine of Blood} in @loc{Damp Caverns} or @loc{Temple of the Elders}. Use it when its health cost will leave you alive with less than 5% health.

achievements.description: Pass a shrine 4 times in a row.
achievements.summary: Receive items from four consecutive shrine attempts.

steps.text: Keep paying shrines until four attempts in a row award an item. A failed attempt breaks the streak; start a new streak at another shrine if needed.

achievements.description: Mercenary: Beat the game on Monsoon difficulty.
achievements.summary: Win a Monsoon run as Mercenary.

steps.text: Choose @mechanic{Monsoon} difficulty and play as @mechanic{Mercenary}. Defeat @enemy{Providence} to finish the run.

achievements.description: Beat the game 5 times.
achievements.summary: Win five runs.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Providence} to finish a run, then earn four more victories. Any difficulty counts.

achievements.description: Mercenary: Eviscerate 50 enemies.
achievements.summary: Use Eviscerate on 50 enemies as Mercenary.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Eviscerate} against enemies while playing @mechanic{Mercenary} until the counter reaches 50.

achievements.description: Obtain Meat Nugget, Bustling Fungus, Sprouting Egg, Bitter Root and Foreign Fruit in one run.
achievements.summary: Collect Bitter Root, Foreign Fruit, Meat Nugget, Sprouting Egg, and Bustling Fungus during one run.

collectibles.name: Bitter Root
collectibles.method: First reach 650 health to unlock Bitter Root. Collect this item.

achievements.description: CHEF: SEAR/FLAMBE 20 Sand Crabs
achievements.summary: Use SEAR or FLAMBE on 20 Sand Crabs as CHEF.

steps.text: As @mechanic{CHEF}, kill @enemy{Sand Crabs} in @loc{Dried Lake} with @mechanic{SEAR}. Use @mechanic{SECOND HELPING} before SEAR to cast FLAMBE instead.

achievements.description: CHEF: Have 20 cleavers out at once.
achievements.summary: Keep 20 cleavers airborne at the same time as CHEF.

steps.text: Get @item{Shattered Mirror} equipment as @mechanic{CHEF}.
Activate Shattered Mirror, use @mechanic{SECOND HELPING}, then cast @mechanic{DICE} two or three times before the cleavers return.

achievements.description: Obtain 30 unique items in one playthrough.
achievements.summary: Collect 30 different items during one run.

steps.text: Choose new item types throughout a run until you have collected 30 different items. Extra copies of an item do not add new types.

achievements.description: Loader: Travel 6,500 meters using the Hydraulic Gauntlet
achievements.summary: Cover 6,500 meters with Hydraulic Gauntlet as Loader.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Hydraulic Gauntlet} to travel while playing @mechanic{Loader}. Keep using the skill across runs until the total distance reaches 6,500 meters.

achievements.description: Loader: Kill the Overloading Magma Worm.
achievements.summary: Defeat an Overloading Magma Worm as Loader.

steps.text: Before starting a @mechanic{Loader} run, enable @mechanic{Artifact of Prestige}. Activate the first stage’s @mechanic{Shrine of the Mountain}, then finish that stage.

Start the second-stage teleporter with one or two Shrine of the Mountain stacks. If an @enemy{Overloading Magma Worm} appears, kill it. Use @mechanic{Debris Shield} as the worm passes through you; try another run if the boss does not spawn.

achievements.description: Commando: Activate the 3rd teleporter without being hurt once.
achievements.summary: Activate the third teleporter as Commando without taking any damage beforehand.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Commando} and reach the third stage without taking damage, including fall damage. Use @mechanic{Tactical Dive} to avoid hits and hard landings.
Activate the third teleporter. If you take damage before activation, begin another run.

achievements.description: Acrid: Kill Acrid in less than 15 seconds.
achievements.summary: Defeat the caged Acrid in under 15 seconds while playing Acrid.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Acrid} and find the cage in the upper-right of a suitable @loc{Sunken Tombs} layout.
Release the caged @enemy{Acrid} and defeat the boss in under 15 seconds. If the fight takes too long, try again on another run.

achievements.description: HAN-D: Obtain a golden drone.
achievements.summary: Acquire a golden drone as HAN-D.

steps.text: As @mechanic{HAN-D}, collect three @item{Attack Drones}. Each Attack Drone can be made by combining three Gunner Drones at a @mechanic{Drone Upgrader}.
Use a Drone Upgrader with three Attack Drones to create one @item{Gilded Attack Drone}. Upgraders appear on stages 3–5 and on looped stages, excluding the final stage.

achievements.description: HAN-D: Kill 15 enemies at once using the Sawmerang.
achievements.summary: Kill 15 enemies with one Sawmerang attack as HAN-D.

steps.text: Obtain @item{Sawmerang} equipment while playing @mechanic{HAN-D}.
Leave a @enemy{Toxic Beast} alive and let three waves of its piglets gather beneath a rope or ladder. Drop down and throw Sawmerang through the group to kill at least 15 together.

achievements.description: Sniper: Beat the third stage without any players collecting items or equipment.
achievements.summary: Clear the first three stages as Sniper without any player picking up items or equipment.

steps.text: Choose @mechanic{Sniper} and avoid every item and equipment pickup for the first three stages. Any teammate must also avoid pickups.
Finish the third stage. If anyone collects an item or equipment before then, restart the attempt.

achievements.description: Sniper: Kill Providence while backflipping.
achievements.summary: Defeat Providence during a Sniper backflip.

steps.text: Keep @mechanic{Military Training} equipped as @mechanic{Sniper}. Build a group of drones and take them to @enemy{Providence}.
Bring Providence close to death, then backflip with Military Training as your drones deliver the killing damage. A missed timing can be tried in another Providence fight.

achievements.description: Drifter: Get 20 temporary items at once.
achievements.summary: Hold 20 temporary items at the same time as Drifter.

steps.text: As @mechanic{Drifter}, collect @item{Substandard Duplicator} to gain temporary copies of pickups.

Build scrap and use @mechanic{Salvage} to create temporary items. Collect the items quickly and keep using Salvage until 20 temporary items overlap. @item{Ancient Scepter} increases Salvage output from four to six items.

achievements.description: Pilot: Kill 30 enemies after launching them using Airstrike.
achievements.summary: Kill 30 enemies launched by Airstrike while playing Pilot.

steps.text: As @mechanic{Pilot}, launch enemies with @mechanic{Airstrike}, then use @mechanic{Target Acquired!} from the ground to shoot the airborne enemies. Accumulate 30 kills.

achievements.description: Pilot: Kill 10 enemies without touching the ground or geysers.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 enemies as Pilot without landing or touching a geyser between the kills.

steps.text: As @mechanic{Pilot}, let a @enemy{Toxic Beast} produce two waves of piglets, then gather the piglets beside a ledge.

Use @mechanic{Rapid Deployment} to launch yourself from the ledge. Kill at least 10 piglets with @mechanic{Target Acquired!} before landing or touching a geyser. If you land too soon, gather another group and try again.

achievements.description: Huntress: Defeat 3 unique event bosses in one run.
achievements.summary: Defeat three different hidden event bosses during one Huntress run.

steps.text: As @mechanic{Huntress}, open the cage in the upper-right of @loc{Sunken Tombs} and kill @enemy{Acrid}.
In @loc{Magma Barracks}, follow the lava tunnel off the bottom-right edge and kill @enemy{Direseeker}. Loop for another chance if a required stage or boss is absent.
Defeat @enemy{Providence} on the final stage as your third different event boss. Killing the same boss twice does not supply another unique boss.

achievements.description: Artificer: Multi-kill 15 enemies.
achievements.summary: Kill 15 enemies together as Artificer.

steps.text: As @mechanic{Artificer}, leave a @enemy{Toxic Beast} alive while three waves of piglets gather beneath a rope or ladder.
Drop into range and hit the group with an area attack to kill at least 15 together. @item{Gold-Plated Bomb} equipment also works.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "A Toxic Path".
achievements.summary: Complete the "A Toxic Path" Providence Trial.

guide.context: A normal clear is enough; gold is optional. If you fail, restart the trial.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Providence Trials} and complete neighboring trials until "A Toxic Path" opens.
Finish three laps of the fungal cavern within 2 minutes 59 seconds.

achievements.description: Visit 10 unique stages.
achievements.summary: Visit 10 different stages across your runs.

collectibles.name: Desolate Forest
collectibles.method: Visit this area during a run.

collectibles.name: Dried Lake
collectibles.method: Visit this area during a run.

collectibles.name: Damp Caverns
collectibles.method: Visit this area during a run.

collectibles.name: Sky Meadow
collectibles.method: Visit this area during a run.

collectibles.name: Ancient Valley
collectibles.method: Visit this area during a run.

collectibles.name: Sunken Tombs
collectibles.method: Visit this area during a run.

collectibles.name: Magma Barracks
collectibles.method: Visit this area during a run.

collectibles.name: Hive Cluster
collectibles.method: Visit this area during a run.

collectibles.name: Temple of the Elders
collectibles.method: Visit this area during a run.

collectibles.name: Risk of Rain
collectibles.method: Visit this area during a run.

achievements.description: Recycle 6 drones in one playthrough.
achievements.summary: Scrap six drones during the same run.

steps.text: Repair drones and find a @mechanic{Drone Scrapper} on stages 3–5 or a looped stage. Scrappers do not appear on the final stage, @loc{Risk of Rain}. Use the scrapper to trade a drone for an item.
Scrap six drones before that run ends. Each activation consumes one drone. If the run ends early, start the six-drone attempt again.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Brave Heart, Steady Hand". Alternatively: Complete 25 stages as Commando.
achievements.summary: Complete the "Brave Heart, Steady Hand" Providence Trial, or finish 25 stages with Commando.

guide.context: A normal trial clear is enough; a gold rank is optional. If the attempt fails, restart the trial.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Providence Trials} and clear adjacent trials until "Brave Heart, Steady Hand" is available.
In "Brave Heart, Steady Hand", defeat the Elder Lemurian with Combat Knife within 9 minutes 59 seconds.
For the ordinary-run route, finish a total of 25 stages while playing @mechanic{Commando} across your runs.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Slide to the Finish!". Alternatively: Defeat 3,000 enemies as Commando.
achievements.summary: Complete the "Slide to the Finish!" Providence Trial, or reach 3,000 enemy kills with Commando.

guide.context: A normal trial clear is enough; a gold rank is optional. If the attempt fails, restart the trial.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Providence Trials} and clear adjacent trials until "Slide to the Finish!" is available.

For the ordinary-run route, earn 3,000 kills while playing @mechanic{Commando} across your runs.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "A Colossal Feat". Alternatively: Collect 300 items as Commando.
achievements.summary: Complete the "A Colossal Feat" Providence Trial, or collect 300 items while playing Commando.

guide.context: A normal trial clear is enough; a gold rank is optional. If the attempt fails, restart the trial.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Providence Trials} and select "A Colossal Feat", the starting trial.
In "A Colossal Feat", defeat the final Colossus and the enemies guarding it in under 4 minutes 59 seconds.
For the ordinary-run route, pick up a total of 300 items while playing @mechanic{Commando} across your runs.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "S.O.S.".
achievements.summary: Complete the "S.O.S." Providence Trial.

guide.context: A normal clear is enough; gold is optional. If you fail, restart the trial.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Providence Trials} and complete neighboring trials until "S.O.S." opens.
Fly the drone around the cavern and destroy at least 50 targets.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Scavenger Hunt". Alternatively: Collect 300 items as Enforcer.
achievements.summary: Complete the "Scavenger Hunt" Providence Trial, or collect 300 items while playing Enforcer.

guide.context: A normal trial clear is enough; a gold rank is optional. If the attempt fails, restart the trial.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Providence Trials} and clear adjacent trials until "Scavenger Hunt" is available.
In "Scavenger Hunt", collect items and drones, then defeat the Scavenger in under 4 minutes 59 seconds.
For the ordinary-run route, pick up a total of 300 items while playing @mechanic{Enforcer} across your runs.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Specimen Sampling". Alternatively: Complete 25 stages as Enforcer.
achievements.summary: Complete the "Specimen Sampling" Providence Trial, or finish 25 stages with Enforcer.

guide.context: A normal trial clear is enough; a gold rank is optional. If the attempt fails, restart the trial.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Providence Trials} and clear adjacent trials until "Specimen Sampling" is available.
Lead the two Gups across the stage to the collecting device. Use Shield Tackle to cross hazards, but stay ahead of the Gups so the tackle does not damage them.
Deliver at least 4 points of creatures within 110 seconds. Each Gup is worth 7 points, each Geep 3, and each Gip 1.
For the ordinary-run route, finish a total of 25 stages while playing @mechanic{Enforcer} across your runs.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Go On Without Me". Alternatively: Defeat 3,000 enemies as Enforcer.
achievements.summary: Complete the "Go On Without Me" Providence Trial, or reach 3,000 enemy kills with Enforcer.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Providence Trials} and clear adjacent trials until "Go On Without Me" is available.
In "Go On Without Me", kill at least 85 Lemurians.
For the ordinary-run route, earn 3,000 kills while playing @mechanic{Enforcer} across your runs.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Inner Demons".
achievements.summary: Complete the "Inner Demons" Providence Trial.

guide.context: A normal clear is enough; gold is optional. If you fail, restart the trial.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Providence Trials} and complete neighboring trials until "Inner Demons" opens.
Defeat your shadows in under 3 minutes 59 seconds.

For the ordinary-run route, pick up a total of 300 items while playing @mechanic{Huntress} across your runs.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Piercing Space and Time". Alternatively: Defeat 3,000 enemies as Huntress.
achievements.summary: Complete the "Piercing Space and Time" Providence Trial, or reach 3,000 enemy kills with Huntress.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Providence Trials} and complete neighboring trials until "Hot-Rope Hop" opens.
Move through the magma cavern on its ropes and break 10 targets.

guide.context: A normal trial clear is enough; a gold rank is optional. If the attempt fails, restart the trial.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Providence Trials} and clear adjacent trials until "Castle of Memories" is available.

For the ordinary-run route, earn 3,000 kills while playing @mechanic{Bandit} across your runs.

achievements.summary: Complete the "Highway Robbery" Providence Trial, or collect 300 items while playing Bandit.

guide.context: A normal trial clear is enough; a gold rank is optional. If the attempt fails, restart the trial.

guide.context: A normal trial clear is enough; a gold rank is optional. If the attempt fails, restart the trial.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Providence Trials} and clear adjacent trials until "Drowning in Research" is available.

For the ordinary-run route, earn 3,000 kills while playing @mechanic{Engineer} across your runs.

achievements.summary: Complete the "From All Angles" Providence Trial, or finish 25 stages with Engineer.

guide.context: A normal trial clear is enough; a gold rank is optional. If the attempt fails, restart the trial.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Providence Trials} and clear adjacent trials until "From All Angles" is available.

For the ordinary-run route, finish a total of 25 stages while playing @mechanic{Engineer} across your runs.

achievements.description: Engineer: Acquire a Beam Drone.
achievements.summary: Obtain a Beam Drone while playing Engineer.

steps.text: As @mechanic{Engineer}, repair three @item{Laser Drones}. Find a @mechanic{Drone Upgrader} on stages 3–5 or a looped stage; none appear on the final stage, @loc{Risk of Rain}.
Activate the upgrader to merge the Laser Drones into one @item{Beam Drone}. You can also buy a broken Beam Drone found on a later stage.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Get Off My Lawn!".
achievements.summary: Complete the "Get Off My Lawn!" Providence Trial.

guide.context: A normal clear is enough; gold is optional. If you fail, restart the trial.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Providence Trials} and complete neighboring trials until "Get Off My Lawn!" opens.
Kill the plants and collect their healing items. Survive until the three-minute endpoint with at least 750 health; reaching 5,000 health ends the trial early.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Caustic Climb". Alternatively: Collect 300 items as Acrid.
achievements.summary: Complete the "Caustic Climb" Providence Trial, or collect 300 items while playing Acrid.

guide.context: A normal trial clear is enough; a gold rank is optional. If the attempt fails, restart the trial.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Providence Trials} and clear adjacent trials until "Caustic Climb" is available.
In "Caustic Climb", bounce on Toxic Bubbles and reach a height of 70 meters within the time limit.
For the ordinary-run route, pick up a total of 300 items while playing @mechanic{Acrid} across your runs.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Uncontrolled Experiment". Alternatively: Defeat 3,000 enemies as Acrid.
achievements.summary: Complete the "Uncontrolled Experiment" Providence Trial, or reach 3,000 enemy kills with Acrid.

guide.context: A normal trial clear is enough; a gold rank is optional. If the attempt fails, restart the trial.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Providence Trials} and clear adjacent trials until "Uncontrolled Experiment" is available.
In "Uncontrolled Experiment", break every target within 1 minute 29 seconds. Use Dissolving Ambush to warp across the large gaps.
For the ordinary-run route, earn 3,000 kills while playing @mechanic{Acrid} across your runs.

achievements.description: Find the illegal shipment.
achievements.summary: Open the hidden shipment containing The Toxin.

steps.text: Search the background chests on the final stage, @loc{Risk of Rain}, for a chest with a brighter latch.
Press the interact button beside that chest to open the hidden shipment. No interaction prompt appears.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Ruins of the Future". Alternatively: Collect 300 items as Loader.
achievements.summary: Complete the "Ruins of the Future" Providence Trial, or collect 300 items while playing Loader.

guide.context: A normal trial clear is enough; a gold rank is optional. If the attempt fails, restart the trial.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Providence Trials} and clear adjacent trials until "Ruins of the Future" is available.
In "Ruins of the Future", kill all 25 Mechanical Spiders before they escape.
For the ordinary-run route, pick up a total of 300 items while playing @mechanic{Loader} across your runs.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Crash Landing". Alternatively: Defeat 3,000 enemies as Loader.
achievements.summary: Complete the "Crash Landing" Providence Trial, or reach 3,000 enemy kills with Loader.

guide.context: A normal trial clear is enough; a gold rank is optional. If the attempt fails, restart the trial.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Providence Trials} and clear adjacent trials until "Crash Landing" is available.
In "Crash Landing", score 40 points within the time limit, using airborne Short Circuit to move through the cavern.
For the ordinary-run route, earn 3,000 kills while playing @mechanic{Loader} across your runs.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Colossal Lift". Alternatively: Complete 25 stages as Loader.

guide.context: A normal trial clear is enough; a gold rank is optional. If the attempt fails, restart the trial.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Providence Trials} and clear adjacent trials until "Colossal Lift" is available.
In "Colossal Lift", kill 10 Colossi; use S260 Conduit to strengthen repaired drones.
For the ordinary-run route, finish a total of 25 stages while playing @mechanic{Loader} across your runs.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Don't Think, Feel". Alternatively: Complete 25 stages as Mercenary.
achievements.summary: Complete the "Don't Think, Feel" Providence Trial, or finish 25 stages with Mercenary.

guide.context: A normal trial clear is enough; a gold rank is optional. If the attempt fails, restart the trial.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Providence Trials} and clear adjacent trials until "Don't Think, Feel" is available.
In "Don't Think, Feel", parry at least 10 attacks with Focused Strike.
For the ordinary-run route, finish a total of 25 stages while playing @mechanic{Mercenary} across your runs.

achievements.summary: Complete the "Assassination Contract" Providence Trial, or collect 300 items while playing Mercenary.

guide.context: A normal trial clear is enough; a gold rank is optional. If the attempt fails, restart the trial.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Providence Trials} and clear adjacent trials until "Assassination Contract" is available.
In "Assassination Contract", defeat the six bosses near the scattered teleporters within 24 minutes 59 seconds. Use Skyward Assault to travel between them.
For the ordinary-run route, pick up a total of 300 items while playing @mechanic{Mercenary} across your runs.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Shadows of the Past". Alternatively: Defeat 3,000 enemies as Mercenary.
achievements.summary: Complete the "Shadows of the Past" Providence Trial, or reach 3,000 enemy kills with Mercenary.

guide.context: A normal trial clear is enough; a gold rank is optional. If the attempt fails, restart the trial.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Providence Trials} and clear adjacent trials until "Shadows of the Past" is available.
In "Shadows of the Past", defeat your shadow clone within 5 minutes.
For the ordinary-run route, earn 3,000 kills while playing @mechanic{Mercenary} across your runs.

achievements.summary: Complete the "Routine Maintenance" Providence Trial, or reach 3,000 enemy kills with HAN-D.

In "Routine Maintenance", kill at least 25 enemies on top of the bridge.
For the ordinary-run route, earn 3,000 kills while playing @mechanic{HAN-D} across your runs.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Think of the Children".
achievements.summary: Finish "Think of the Children" in Providence Trials.

guide.context: From the main menu, open @mechanic{Providence Trials}. Start with A Colossal Feat, then clear adjacent trials to open a path to this trial; its survivor must also be unlocked. A failed attempt can be restarted.

steps.text: Enter @mechanic{Think of the Children} as @npc{HAN-D}. Defeat wandering Golems for keycards, then escort 5 or more Children until they reach the distant Parent.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Main Systems Offline".
achievements.summary: Clear the Providence Trial "Main Systems Offline".

guide.context: From the main menu, open @mechanic{Providence Trials}. Start with A Colossal Feat, then clear adjacent trials to open a path to this trial; its survivor must also be unlocked. A failed attempt can be restarted.

steps.text: Enter @mechanic{Main Systems Offline} as @npc{HAN-D}. Fire Drones at the invaders to earn at least 200 points. Tougher enemies give more points, and points award keycards.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "A Fresh Harvest". Alternatively: Collect 300 items as CHEF.
achievements.summary: Clear the Providence Trial "A Fresh Harvest" or collect 300 items as CHEF.

guide.context: From the main menu, open @mechanic{Providence Trials}. Start with A Colossal Feat, then clear adjacent trials to open a path to this trial; its survivor must also be unlocked. A failed attempt can be restarted.

steps.text: Enter @mechanic{A Fresh Harvest} as @npc{CHEF}. Kill at least 20 Lemurians before the timer ends. Pick up Bonus Time before the pickups disappear.
Alternatively, Collect 300 items as CHEF.

achievements.description: CHEF: Simultaneously kill 15 oiled enemies using SEAR/FLAMBE
achievements.summary: Kill 15 oil-covered enemies at the same time with SEAR or FLAMBE as CHEF.

steps.text: Avoid items that deal damage automatically or hit nearby enemies, such as Tesla Coil, Frost Relic, Toxic Centipede, Fire Shield, and Chargefield Generator. They can kill piglets before you gather the group.
As @npc{CHEF}, find a Toxic Beast and let it spawn three waves of piglets while you wait on a nearby rope or ladder.
Gather at least 15 piglets, coat the group with GLAZE, and kill the group together with SEAR or FLAMBE.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "The Right Ingredients". Alternatively: Defeat 3,000 enemies as CHEF.
achievements.summary: Clear the Providence Trial "The Right Ingredients" or defeat 3,000 enemies as CHEF.

guide.context: From the main menu, open @mechanic{Providence Trials}. Start with A Colossal Feat, then clear adjacent trials to open a path to this trial; its survivor must also be unlocked. A failed attempt can be restarted.

steps.text: Enter @mechanic{The Right Ingredients} as @npc{CHEF}. Use COOK to prepare at least 15 enemies before time expires. Deaths reduce your score.
Alternatively, play CHEF and kill a total of 3,000 enemies.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Kited Blades".
achievements.summary: Clear the Providence Trial "Kited Blades".

guide.context: From the main menu, open @mechanic{Providence Trials}. Start with A Colossal Feat, then clear adjacent trials to open a path to this trial; its survivor must also be unlocked. A failed attempt can be restarted.

steps.text: Enter @mechanic{Kited Blades} as @npc{CHEF}. Break at least 75 targets before reaching the end of the underwater chasm.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Lightning Strikes Twice". Alternatively: Complete 25 stages as Artificer.
achievements.summary: Clear the Providence Trial "Lightning Strikes Twice" or complete 25 stages as Artificer.

guide.context: From the main menu, open @mechanic{Providence Trials}. Start with A Colossal Feat, then clear adjacent trials to open a path to this trial; its survivor must also be unlocked. A failed attempt can be restarted.

steps.text: Enter @mechanic{Lightning Strikes Twice} as @npc{Artificer}. Pierce at least 7 Golems with one Pulse Spear. Press the skill again as the spear reaches each Golem to extend its piercing effect.
Alternatively, Complete 25 stages as Artificer.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "In the Clouds". Alternatively: Collect 300 items as Artificer.
achievements.summary: Clear the Providence Trial "In the Clouds" or collect 300 items as Artificer.

guide.context: From the main menu, open @mechanic{Providence Trials}. Start with A Colossal Feat, then clear adjacent trials to open a path to this trial; its survivor must also be unlocked. A failed attempt can be restarted.

steps.text: Enter @mechanic{In the Clouds} as @npc{Artificer}. Use Tectonic Surge to climb the tower and reach the goal within 1:55. Cast in midair to create a platform.
Alternatively, Collect 300 items as Artificer.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Danger Orbits". Alternatively: Defeat 3,000 enemies as Artificer.
achievements.summary: Clear the Providence Trial "Danger Orbits" or defeat 3,000 enemies as Artificer.

guide.context: From the main menu, open @mechanic{Providence Trials}. Start with A Colossal Feat, then clear adjacent trials to open a path to this trial; its survivor must also be unlocked. A failed attempt can be restarted.

steps.text: Enter @mechanic{Danger Orbits} as @npc{Artificer}. Burn at least 50 enemies with Localized Sun. Move your body to steer the star.
Alternatively, play Artificer and kill a total of 3,000 enemies.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Meteor Showers".
achievements.summary: Clear the Providence Trial "Meteor Showers".

guide.context: From the main menu, open @mechanic{Providence Trials}. Start with A Colossal Feat, then clear adjacent trials to open a path to this trial; its survivor must also be unlocked. A failed attempt can be restarted.

steps.text: Enter @mechanic{Meteor Showers} as @npc{Sniper}. Earn 40 or more points by activating Glowing Meteorite terminals. Activate the teleporter to double your score.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Lone Wolf".
achievements.summary: Clear the Providence Trial "Lone Wolf".

guide.context: From the main menu, open @mechanic{Providence Trials}. Start with A Colossal Feat, then clear adjacent trials to open a path to this trial; its survivor must also be unlocked. A failed attempt can be restarted.

steps.text: Enter @mechanic{Lone Wolf} as @npc{Sniper}. Defeat at least 35 enemies from the outpost. Enemies move faster as your score rises.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Bullseyes Only". Alternatively: Complete 25 stages as Sniper.
achievements.summary: Clear the Providence Trial "Bullseyes Only" or complete 25 stages as Sniper.

guide.context: From the main menu, open @mechanic{Providence Trials}. Start with A Colossal Feat, then clear adjacent trials to open a path to this trial; its survivor must also be unlocked. A failed attempt can be restarted.

steps.text: Enter @mechanic{Bullseyes Only} as @npc{Sniper}. Break 15 targets in the lava cavern within 2:09. Use Quickscope to shoot through walls.
Alternatively, Complete 25 stages as Sniper.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "A Duplicator?!".
achievements.summary: Clear the Providence Trial "A Duplicator?!".

guide.context: From the main menu, open @mechanic{Providence Trials}. Start with A Colossal Feat, then clear adjacent trials to open a path to this trial; its survivor must also be unlocked. A failed attempt can be restarted.

steps.text: Enter @mechanic{A Duplicator?!} as @npc{Drifter}. Before the timer ends, pick up 100 or more items. Use Salvage to obtain Substandard Duplicators and multiply your item pickups.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Perilous Descent". Alternatively: Collect 300 items as Drifter.
achievements.summary: Clear the Providence Trial "Perilous Descent" or collect 300 items as Drifter.

guide.context: From the main menu, open @mechanic{Providence Trials}. Start with A Colossal Feat, then clear adjacent trials to open a path to this trial; its survivor must also be unlocked. A failed attempt can be restarted.

steps.text: Enter @mechanic{Perilous Descent} as @npc{Drifter}. Reach the cave bottom carrying 100 or more gold. Strike Scrap Cubes to slide them, including while standing on a cube.
Alternatively, Collect 300 items as Drifter.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Equivalent Exchange". Alternatively: Complete 25 stages as Drifter.
achievements.summary: Clear the Providence Trial "Equivalent Exchange" or complete 25 stages as Drifter.

guide.context: From the main menu, open @mechanic{Providence Trials}. Start with A Colossal Feat, then clear adjacent trials to open a path to this trial; its survivor must also be unlocked. A failed attempt can be restarted.

steps.text: Enter @mechanic{Equivalent Exchange} as @npc{Drifter}. Use Recycle on Monster Teeth to get Rusty Knives. Hold at least 8 Rusty Knives before activating the teleporter.
Alternatively, Complete 25 stages as Drifter.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Break the Targets!". Alternatively: Complete 25 stages as Miner.
achievements.summary: Clear the Providence Trial "Break the Targets!" or complete 25 stages as Miner.

guide.context: From the main menu, open @mechanic{Providence Trials}. Start with A Colossal Feat, then clear adjacent trials to open a path to this trial; its survivor must also be unlocked. A failed attempt can be restarted.

steps.text: Enter @mechanic{Break the Targets!} as @npc{Miner}. Break every target within 1:59 using Throwing Axe. Throw pickaxes upward through obstacles to reach targets above you.
Alternatively, Complete 25 stages as Miner.

achievements.description: Kill 8 Elder Lemurians without losing your Scorching status.
achievements.summary: Kill 8 Elder Lemurians during one uninterrupted Scorching period as Miner.

steps.text: Equip Burnout on @npc{Miner}. Build healing and protection with Medkits, Hermit's Scarf, and Prophet's Cape.
Find Elder Lemurians in Magma Barracks or Temple of the Elders; loop stages if necessary. Build heat with Crush or Throwing Axe, then use Burnout between enemies to keep Scorching active.
Kill 8 Elder Lemurians before Scorching ends. If Scorching expires, start the count again during a new Scorching period.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Scorching Heart". Alternatively: Collect 300 items as Miner.
achievements.summary: Clear the Providence Trial "Scorching Heart" or collect 300 items as Miner.

guide.context: From the main menu, open @mechanic{Providence Trials}. Start with A Colossal Feat, then clear adjacent trials to open a path to this trial; its survivor must also be unlocked. A failed attempt can be restarted.

steps.text: Enter @mechanic{Scorching Heart} as @npc{Miner}. Hit enemies with Crush to build heat, then stay Scorching for at least 60 seconds without interruption.
Alternatively, Collect 300 items as Miner.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Gup Sorting?".
achievements.summary: Clear the Providence Trial "Gup Sorting?".

guide.context: The obelisks mark the required enemy sizes and counts. An unsolvable puzzle resets the enemies; restart the trial if the time expires.

steps.text: Unlock Miner, then clear one neighboring trial: Break the Targets!, Scorching Heart, or Equivalent Exchange. Enter @mechanic{Gup Sorting?} as @npc{Miner}.

The finished arrangement needs these groups: the top pen holds 1 Gup; the middle-left pen holds 2 Geeps; the middle-right pen holds 1 Geep; the bottom-left pen holds 1 Gip; the bottom-right pen holds 3 Gips.
Attack the upper-right Gup until it becomes Gips. Drop 3 Gips down the right and guide the fourth toward the bottom-left pen.
Attack the upper-left Gup to produce Geeps, then bring the Geeps to the middle-left pen. Finish within 10 minutes.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Emergency Ejection".
achievements.summary: Clear the Providence Trial "Emergency Ejection".

guide.context: From the main menu, open @mechanic{Providence Trials}. Start with A Colossal Feat, then clear adjacent trials to open a path to this trial; its survivor must also be unlocked. A failed attempt can be restarted.

steps.text: Enter @mechanic{Emergency Ejection} as @npc{Pilot}. Glide down the chasm with your parachute and collect at least 55 points before reaching the bottom.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Race to the Finish!". Alternatively: Collect 300 items as Pilot.
achievements.summary: Finish "Race to the Finish!" in Providence Trials or collect 300 items as Pilot.

guide.context: From the main menu, open @mechanic{Providence Trials}. Start with A Colossal Feat, then clear adjacent trials to open a path to this trial; its survivor must also be unlocked. A failed attempt can be restarted.

steps.text: Enter @mechanic{Race to the Finish!} as @npc{Pilot}. Reach the finish within 1:59. Dash into walls with Aerobatics to cling to and climb them.
Alternatively, Collect 300 items as Pilot.

achievements.description: Complete the Providence Trial "Juggling Priorities".
achievements.summary: Clear the Providence Trial "Juggling Priorities".

guide.context: From the main menu, open @mechanic{Providence Trials}. Start with A Colossal Feat, then clear adjacent trials to open a path to this trial; its survivor must also be unlocked. A failed attempt can be restarted.

steps.text: Enter @mechanic{Juggling Priorities} as @npc{Pilot}. Keep the Crab airborne for at least 25 seconds with Airstrikes. Add Target Acquired shots to slow its fall.

achievements.description: Unlock a survivor.
achievements.summary: Unlock any additional survivor.

steps.text: Unlock a survivor to make @mechanic{Providence Trials} available on the main menu.

achievements.description: Find the Artifact of Honor.
achievements.summary: Obtain the Artifact of Honor.

steps.text: For Desolate Forest variant 1, choose Miner, Loader, or Pilot to reach the artifact without extra items or alternate skills. The same survivors work in variant 2, where Bandit can also reach the route unaided.

In Desolate Forest variant 1, enter the tunnel beneath the waterfall on the left and climb through to the artifact. In variant 2, enter the hidden wall opening on the left. In variant 3, climb down the blue-leaved tree at the upper left.

achievements.description: Find the Artifact of Kin.
achievements.summary: Obtain the Artifact of Kin.

steps.text: In Dried Lake variant 1, 2, or 3, break through the map's right-hand wall. Press the 3 buttons in the hidden room quickly, then collect the artifact.

achievements.description: Find the Artifact of Distortion.
achievements.summary: Obtain the Artifact of Distortion.

steps.text: Use Loader in Damp Caverns variant 1, 2, or 3. Reach the mushroom platforms at the top with Hydraulic Gauntlet, strike the button with a primary attack, and collect the artifact at the gate.

achievements.description: Find the Artifact of Spite.
achievements.summary: Obtain the Artifact of Spite.

steps.text: In Sky Meadow variant 1, 2, or 3, break the floor in the lower-left corner. Follow the platforms beneath the floor to the artifact.

achievements.description: Find the Artifact of Glass.
achievements.summary: Obtain the Artifact of Glass.

steps.text: In Ancient Valley variant 1, 2, or 3, enter the cave on the left through the hidden walls or ropes. Hit its 5 small buttons within 15 seconds and collect the artifact.

achievements.description: Find the Artifact of Enigma.
achievements.summary: Obtain the Artifact of Enigma.

steps.text: In Sunken Tombs variant 1, 2, or 3, drop into the cove at the lower right. Move right to the hidden geyser, ride upward, and follow the tunnel to the artifact.

achievements.description: Find the Artifact of Sacrifice.
achievements.summary: Obtain the Artifact of Sacrifice.

steps.text: In Magma Barracks variant 1, 2, or 3, hit the 3 buttons behind walls with attacks that pass through walls, then collect the artifact. Evolved Lemurian attacks can also press the buttons.

achievements.description: Find the Artifact of Command.
achievements.summary: Obtain the Artifact of Command.

steps.text: In Hive Cluster variant 1, 2, or 3, climb across the vines at the upper right to reach the artifact. The vines remain climbable while invisible.

achievements.description: Find the Artifact of Spirit.
achievements.summary: Obtain the Artifact of Spirit.

guide.context: The pickup can award an Acrid prism instead of achievement credit. After collecting Spirit, check that the Spirit challenge and Steam achievement both unlocked.

steps.text: Drop beneath the far-right side of Temple of the Elders variant 1, 2, or 3 and follow the platforms to the artifact. Falling returns you above ground so you can try the platforms again.

achievements.description: Find the Artifact of Origin.
achievements.summary: Obtain the Artifact of Origin.

guide.context: Origin can become selectable before its challenge is completed, and the intended unlock can then fail to award Steam credit. Check the challenge and Steam achievement after defeating Providence.

steps.text: Enable these 9 artifacts before the run: Command, Honor, Glass, Spirit, Kin, Enigma, Spite, Sacrifice, and Distortion. Defeat Providence with those 9 artifacts active.

achievements.description: Get a gold rank on at least 15 Providence Trials.
achievements.summary: Earn gold ranks on at least 15 different Providence Trials.

steps.text: Clear adjacent trials to expand the trial board. Meet the displayed gold target on 15 distinct trials; ordinary completion ranks do not count.

achievements.description: Find the 4 hidden Artifact Shards.
achievements.summary: Collect the four distinct Artifact Shards to unlock the Artifact of Dissonance.

guide.context: Use the Modern ruleset for variants 4 to 6. Take one shard from each listed stage; progress carries across runs.

collectibles.name: Ancient Valley shard
collectibles.location: Right side of the central mountain, variants 4 to 6.
collectibles.method: Find the hidden chain or rope at the mountain top and descend to the shard.

collectibles.name: Sunken Tombs shard
collectibles.location: Underwater near the bottom middle of variant 6.
collectibles.method: Search near the underwater environment log and collect the shard.

collectibles.name: Magma Barracks shard
collectibles.location: Near the upper right of variant 6.
collectibles.method: Reach the upper-right shard location and pick up the shard.

collectibles.name: Hive Cluster shard
collectibles.method: Climb the hidden flesh-rope and enter the passage shared with the environment log to collect the shard.

achievements.description: Find the Artifact of Tempus.
achievements.summary: Obtain the Artifact of Tempus.

guide.context: The artifact disappears at 16:00; make another run if the time limit passes.

steps.text: Reach Temple of the Elders before the run timer reaches 16 minutes. Enter the hole in the background wall of the middle tower and collect the artifact before 16:00.

achievements.description: Find the Artifact of Cognation.
achievements.summary: Obtain the Artifact of Cognation.

steps.text: On the Modern ruleset, find Desolate Forest variant 4. Climb down the hidden vine in the lower-right corner and press both buttons in the hidden room.
Defeat the Desecrated Rock Golem, then collect the Artifact of Cognation. Stay near the arena: moving too far away can despawn the Golem.

achievements.description: Complete Judgement as Artificer.
achievements.summary: Clear Judgement as Artificer.

guide.context: Judgement uses the survivor's default skills. Health does not regenerate naturally, and falling out of bounds kills you. Restart Judgement after a failed attempt.

steps.text: Complete every other Providence Trial to open @mechanic{Judgement}. Start from A Colossal Feat and clear adjacent trials to unlock the rest of the board.
Select @npc{Artificer} for Judgement. Choose items from the multishop terminals before each stage and survive all 10 stages to finish the trial.
